fixes.explanation: You caught it, baker. Judges 1:35 says, “But when the house of Joseph grew in strength, they pressed the Amorites into forced labor.” The house of Joseph got stronger and the Amorites got put to work, but the verse never says they were driven out. That's like shoving the dough to the other side of the counter and calling the counter clean.

problems.problem: “Nobody got sent away” goes beyond the text. Judges 1:35 says the house of Joseph pressed the Amorites into forced labor, but it does not say that no one was sent away.
